result:
Round 474 (DPG-P0-1) is implemented and every check I ran passes. The task's C10 row needs a B ruling: read literally, it fails on a correct tree. The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-474.md`, with logs in `a-round-474/`.

**What changed**
- **B's sketch, applied byte for byte** (`app.css`, `utilities.css`, `StemControl.tsx`, `StemsPlayerModal.tsx`; shas match B's list, re-checked after every mutant):
  - the 7 unused crystal/premium colour tokens are deleted;
  - the glow, video-sync and 5 gradient tokens now use brass tokens;
  - the dead rules' teal is replaced with brass in place.
- **New scanner, `hueRangeColourHits`**, added to the test helper (`style-scan.ts`) with no existing line removed. It flags any colour with hue 160–200° in every colour syntax and in Tailwind classes. On the live `app/` it finds only the frozen legacy Studio teal: `StudioTrack.tsx` 1 and the two `studio.css` copies, 4 each.
- **Test edits in the 3 test files:** no assertion was dropped without an equal or stronger replacement. New rows are HUE1–3, LT11, ST3b and GR1, and ST3 now checks 29 keys. For LT7 I replaced only its first checks, as the task requires, and kept every other check unchanged. Those checks prove the brass-swapped rules still render nowhere.
- **Doc 307** follows the template headings, with line 4 written exactly as required.

**Checks run**
- typecheck, lint and Biome on the owned paths: all exit 0.
- The 14 covering test files: 158 of 158 pass. On the sketch alone, before my test edits, exactly LT3, LT5, LT7, TS2 and ST3 failed, as B predicted.
- `npm run build`: exit 0. The built CSS has the same 21 teal selectors as a separate HEAD `58fc56e` build, all coming from old docs that Tailwind scans. My first draft of doc 307 would have added one; I removed it.
- Mutants: HUE3, M-GR1, M-ST, M-TS and an extra one for the `_` fix each turned their target rows red, and all were reverted.
- code-reviewer (actual subagent, 7/10) found 1 High, 3 Medium and some Lows:
  - Fixed: the scanner missing colours inside Tailwind `_` values, `href="#…"` counted as a colour, and an LT7 check that could never fail.
  - The remaining Medium (the visible legacy loader change below) is now recorded in doc 307.
  - Smaller unsupported colour syntaxes are recorded as gaps.
  - Its architecture note is a proposal for B/root only: move the colour scanner into its own helper file. Not done.

**For B**
- **C10:** it allows only K1, K2b, K13 and K13b to change. B's own required edits also change K16 (the 26→29 pin), K17 (a line shift from the deleted tokens) and K18 (the old LT7 lower bound). K10 is unchanged.
- **SIG-R474-LEGACY-LOADER-SCROLLBAR:** the sketch's `utilities.css` change turns the stems-loader scrollbar brass on the frozen legacy `/studio/$productId` page. This is the only visible change. At rest the thumb's contrast drops from 2.59:1 to 2.28:1; both were already below 3:1. That figure assumes a `#0e0d0c` page background, which I didn't verify. I didn't change it because the sketch is byte for byte. B can keep it or fold it into the Saba question on legacy Studio teal.
- **SIG-R474-DOCS-TAILWIND-TEAL:** old docs that Tailwind scans put 21 unused teal utilities into the production CSS. This is unchanged from HEAD and outside my grant.
- **Contrast:** the Solo active state (dark text on brass) is 8.32:1 and the stems modal spinner is 7.88:1. Both are arithmetic only, because the component can't be opened in the browser.

**Not run:** I didn't use a browser (rows C5–C7 and C9 are C's), and per the speed rules I didn't run repo-wide `npm run check`, the full suite or `verify`; those are gate rows. No commits.
